headline: Moody's upgrades Global Mining Corp to Baa2 on strong uranium demand
summary: Moody's upgraded Global Mining Corp to Baa2 from Baa3. Outlook stable. Driven by robust uranium market fundamentals and improved cash flow from increased production.

headline: URA sees $250M inflow amid uranium supply concerns
summary: Global X Uranium ETF (URA) recorded $250M inflow over past week. Year-to-date inflows now exceed $1.2B. Largest weekly inflow since Q2 2023.

headline: US Treasury imposes new sanctions on Iranian energy entities
summary: OFAC designated 12 entities involved in Iranian petroleum trade. Restrictions effective immediately. Expected impact on Middle East oil flows and insurance markets.

headline: Red Sea tensions escalate: major shipping lines reroute via Cape of Good Hope
summary: Three major container shipping lines announced indefinite rerouting around Africa. Adds 10-14 days to Europe-Asia transit. Expected impact on freight rates and supply chains.

headline: Lithium extraction startup files for $800M IPO
summary: Advanced Lithium Technologies filed S-1 for $800M IPO. Company operates direct lithium extraction facilities in Nevada. Goldman Sachs and Morgan Stanley lead underwriters.

headline: Energy Corp receives uranium mining license approval in Wyoming
summary: Energy Corp (NYSE: ENGY) announced regulatory approval for uranium mining operations. Expected production: 2M lbs/year starting Q3 2024. Project capex estimated at $450M.
